attr.title: RECry (Far Cry)
attr.desc: RECry: Far Cry (2004) on the original CryEngine, built for Linux and OpenGL ES 3 from the released engine source, with the original cutscenes. Your own GOG copy of the game is required. About 30 FPS on the H700 with the handheld options; any screen size and aspect ratio.
attr.inst: Copy RECry.sh into your Ports folder and recry into ports. Put both files of the GOG installer (setup_far_cry_1.40_hotfix_(29940).exe and its -1.bin) into recry/installer. Start RECry: the first start unpacks the game (about 3.5 GB, takes a while). See README.md.
